messages:
Alex M.: Quick check — rolling token-attrib v2 schema + latency fields today. Need owners, downstream blocking services, and a PR ping. Planning canary to 5% on prod next Tue. Outline below, pls confirm by EOD.

Priya R.: I'm owner for analytics side. Will validate attribution joins + sample counts. Blocking: need consistent event.field 'token_cost_usd' from ingest.

Jordan L.: I'll handle runtime tagging (model_id + quantization). Question: do we add token_cost per response or compute in batch? For latency, adding 'service_latency_ms' at transport layer looks easiest.

Maya S.: Analytics needs both token_cost and per-token latency. If cost only at response-level we're fine, but per-token helps attribution for streaming. Also confirm event schema change won't break current ETL.

Sam T.: Ingest team: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/452. Adds schema v2 and a small shim in the collector. I put a feature flag: INSTR_V2=true. Will gate for canary.

Priya R.: Reviewing PR now. Head's up: needs spec update in docs repo + example payload.

Alex M.: Here's suggested minimal event snippet to land (feel free to tweak):
```json
{
  "event_type": "inference_result",
  "model": "redwood-mini-v1",
  "request_id": "uuid",
  "tokens_generated": 24,
  "token_cost_usd": 0.0024,
  "service_latency_ms": 120,
  "per_token_latency_ms": [5,4,3,...]
}
```
Also SQL to derive token-cost per customer:
```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(token_cost_usd) AS spend
FROM events_v2
WHERE event_type='inference_result' AND occurred_at >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

Jordan L.: small note — per_token_latency_ms is an array; it will blow up storage. Maybe keep a histogram buckets instead? e.g., latency_buckets: {"0-5":10,"5-10":14} 

Maya S.: Agreed. Let's do latency_buckets + sample_percentile (p50,p95).

Claire (deploy-bot): canary deployment scheduled: infra-deploy/2026-03-17T15:00Z -> success for 5% traffic. :white_check_mark:

Sam T.: After canary, we need a smoke test: join counts match old schema for last 24h ± 1%. Maya/Priya can you own smoke checks?

Priya R.: Yes. I'll run the join counts + token_cost sanity.

Maya S.: I'll run percentile deltas and check embeddings pipeline doesn't break.

Alex M.: Owner list: Priya (analytics), Jordan (runtime tags), Sam (ingest PR/rollout), Maya (smoke checks), Alex (scheduler/rollout). Dependencies: billing team for downstream cost attribution (cc @billing-team). Claire (infra) — any infra blockers?

Claire (deploy-bot): No infra blockers. Watcher: billing-ingest team needs ACL approval. Ping @billing-team.

Jordan L.: One more PR note: added metric prefix_cache_hit as metric name. Sam/T, please ensure collector exposes it.

Sam T.: Will add to PR now.

Alex M.: Final ask: if you want to be removed from canary or opt-out, DM me. Otherwise we'll proceed EOD unless major blockers.
